title: Embedding unit-price ladder and enterprise QSA prep (batch discount experiments)
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Context: Enterprise customers increasingly ask for clearer per-vector economics and predictable cost when operating high-volume similarity and reranking pipelines. Current pricing is per-embedding unit with limited bulk discounts; sales and contracts teams report friction during QSA/security reviews where pricing tables and billing semantics are unclear. This ticket coordinates a short experiment to introduce a tiered per-vector price ladder and a parallel checklist to satisfy enterprise security questionnaire items tied to pricing (e.g., data handling that affects billable units).

Goals:
- Validate demand elasticity for per-vector price tiers and batch volume discounts.
- Produce a canonical pricing grid and contract language for Sales to use in QSA responses.
- Ensure billing and telemetry can support new dimensions (per-vector, per-batch, discount code application).

Hypotheses:
- H1: Offering a 10-20% discount for monthly vector volumes > 50M will increase enterprise adoption of reranking features with minimal revenue dilution.
- H2: A per-batch pricing addendum (discounts applied to calls with batch_size >= 64) will reduce cost per query for high-throughput customers and increase average daily request volume.

Experiment design:
- Pricing variants (A/B test across new self-serve accounts and sales proposals):
  * Control: current per-vector pricing (baseline).
  * Variant 1: Tiered ladder: 0-1M vectors $0.0008/vector, 1M-50M $0.0006, >50M $0.00048.
  * Variant 2: Batch-first: same base price as control but apply a 12% discount when single API call contains >=64 vectors.
  * Variant 3: Combined ladder + batch bonus: tiers as Variant 1 plus additional 6% for calls with batch_size>=128.
- Allocation: route 25% of new signups into variants for 12 weeks. Sales proposals for warm leads will include Variant 1 or Variant 3 as negotiable options.
- Metrics: RETENTION_RATE_30d, ARPU_vector, revenue_per_query, avg_batch_size, percent_requests_with_discount, churn_signal_by_pricing_variant, sales_win_rate_post-qsa.

Contract / QSA workstream:
- Produce standard language clarifying billable event (vector output/token produced vs vector MxN semantics), batch discount triggers, and data retention impact on billing.
- Prepare QSA appendix with answers for typical enterprise items: data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration, audit log retention tied to billed usage, and how cached prefixes affect billable counts.
- Owner for QSA artifacts: Legal + Solutions Engineering (primary: Sofia Ruiz). Draft to be available for Sales by 2025-03-20.

Rollout and billing implementation notes:
- Billing change requires a billing dimension change and new aggregation window (daily per-customer vector count + batch-qualified counts). Engineering change requests listed below.
- Prevent surprise bills: add console preview showing projected monthly cost under each tier.
- For existing committed contracts, offer one-time migration to new ladder with opt-in incentive (3 months free batch discounts).
